程序包 org.bukkit.configuration

类 ConfigurationOptions

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationOptions
直接已知子类:

public class ConfigurationOptions extends Object
Various settings for controlling the input and output of a Configuration 用于控制 Configuration 输入与输出的各项设置。

    • pathSeparator

      public char pathSeparator()
      Gets the char that will be used to separate ConfigurationSections 获取将用于分隔 ConfigurationSection 的字符。

      This value does not affect how the Configuration is stored, only in how you access the data. The default value is '.'. 此值不影响 Configuration 的存储方式，仅影响你访问数据的方式。默认值为 '.'。

      返回:
      Path separator 路径分隔符。

    • copyDefaults

      public boolean copyDefaults()
      Checks if the Configuration should copy values from its default 检查 Configuration 是否应直接从其默认 Configuration 复制值。 Configuration directly.

      If this is true, all values in the default Configuration will be directly copied, making it impossible to distinguish between values that were set and values that are provided by default. As a result, ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) will always return the same value as ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String). The default value is false. 若为 true，默认 Configuration 中的所有值都将被直接复制，使得已设置的值与默认提供的值无法区分。因此 ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) 将始终返回与 ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String) 相同的结果。默认值为 false。

      返回:
      Whether or not defaults are directly copied 是否直接复制默认值。

    • copyDefaults

As a result, ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) will always return the same value as ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String). The default value is false. 若为 true，默认 Configuration 中的所有值都将被直接复制，使得已设置的值与默认提供的值无法区分。因此 ConfigurationSection.contains(java.lang.String) 将始终返回与 ConfigurationSection.isSet(java.lang.String) 相同的结果。默认值为 false。

      参数:
